run_diatomic_curve_test: run a diatomic potential energy curve test for a pretrained MLIP model on omol or omat tasks
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve for a pair of atoms across a range of distances
get_model: load a pretrained machine learning interatomic potential model from name or path for prediction
generate_plot: generate a matplotlib plot of a diatomic potential energy curve and save it as a PNG file
combined_plot: generate a combined matplotlib plot of multiple diatomic potential energy curves on a single figure
